subject: Re: POC - Stellar Commerce: Risk Tracker & Success Criteria
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC follow-up: success criteria & next steps

Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion. Quick recap and what we need from Redwood to greenlight the POC: 

1) Success criteria (from our side):
 - End-to-end latency for 95th percentile generation under 250ms for typical 512-token prompts when hitting our staging traffic profile.
 - Average inference cost per 1K tokens <= $1.10 (we'll provide traffic sketch).
 - No PII leakage in logs and ability to redact user input on request.
 - Model outputs for our 10 canonical prompts must reach >= 0.8 BLEU/ROUGE baseline compared to our current system.

2) Timeline: 3-week trial starting as soon as staging access is available. Prefer kickoff week of Sep 20.

3) Ownership / contacts:
 - Our technical lead: Aisha Singh (cc'd)
 - Procurement: me (Tom)

Ask for: a short POC plan with owners, a risk/issues tracker we can reference during the trial, and any staging access instructions. Also please attach the success criteria doc if you have one.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform, Stellar Commerce

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@stellarcommerce.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: success criteria & next steps

Tom — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching an initial POC success-criteria workbook and a proposed plan. High level:

- Scope: 3-week trial against your staging environment; we'll run the inference path you use in prod and the 10 canonical prompts you mentioned.
- Kickoff: propose Mon 20 Sep (we can shift if needed).
- Roles:
  - Marissa (AE) — account coordination, timeline
  - Rachel (Solutions Eng) — lead on integration, prompts, eval harness
  - Michael (CS Eng) — monitoring, latency/cost ops, incident lead
  - Aisha — your staging contact/owner

I've also started a simple risk/issue tracker (attached CSV) where we'll log blocking bugs, mitigations, and escalation paths. Key initial assumptions and asks from your side are listed in the workbook.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm kickoff date (20 Sep) and who will provide staging creds?
2) Please review the success criteria tab and flag any additions.
3) We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff to align owners and access.

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx; staging-issue-log.csv

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: risk note re: staging keys / data residency

Chiming in from security — flagged a couple of risks that need explicit mitigations in the tracker before we start hitting staging with live-ish traffic:

1) Staging credentials & key-handling: if Stellar will provide API keys that accept non-production data, confirm keys are scoped and time-limited. We need a documented rotation plan and the ability to revoke immediately.
Mitigation: Require time-bound keys + IP allowlist. Redwood can also accept ephemeral access via our temporary token flow; Rachel / Michael can coordinate.

2) Data residency / logging: Stellar mentioned EU customers in some segments. We need to confirm whether any EU-origin data will be sent during the POC and if so whether logging/audit retention settings meet their obligations.
Mitigation: Option to disable request/response logging for EU-origin traffic, or mask PII at the request layer. If the customer requires, we can route EU traffic to specific region and keep logs there.

3) Blocking bug escalation: propose immediate escalation to execs if POC blocks for >8 hours and we have no mitigation. Michael, can you draft the escalation path (on-call -> CS lead -> engineering manager -> exec)?

I'll add these as items in the tracker once we have the kickoff confirmed.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarcommerce.com>, Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: success criteria & risk tracker (finalized)

Thanks all — quick consolidated update and the next steps so we're aligned before kickoff.

POC basics (confirmed):
- Start: Mon 20 Sep 2026
- Duration: 3 weeks (ends Fri 8 Oct 2026)
- Primary contacts: Tom (Stellar exec), Aisha (Stellar tech), Rachel (Redwood SE lead), Michael (Redwood CS ops)

Success criteria (finalized):
- 95th pct latency <= 250ms for 512-token prompts under your staging profile
- Avg cost per 1K tokens <= $1.10
- No PII in persistent logs; ability to redact on demand (Neha to verify)
- Canonical prompts pass baseline evaluation (>= 0.8 on our agreed metrics)

Risk / initial issues log (summary):
- Issue 1: Staging key scoping & rotation (owner: Aisha / Stellar; mitigation: time-bound keys + IP allowlist; Redwood support: ephemeral token flow)
- Issue 2: EU data in staging (owner: Aisha; mitigation: mask PII or route EU traffic to EU region; Neha to validate logging settings)
- Issue 3: Intermittent 500s seen during small-scale smoke test (owner: Michael; mitigation: rolling restart of serving pool + temporary fallback to smaller model; if >8 hours unresolved escalate per path below)

Escalation path (agreed):
1) On-call CS engineer (Michael) — initial triage and mitigation (0-1h)
2) CS manager (Rachel) — coordinates rollbacks/alternate model (1-4h)
3) Eng manager (TBD) — if engineering changes needed (4-8h)
4) Exec escalation (Marissa + Stellar exec) if POC is blocked >8h and no workaround exists

Action items before kickoff:
- Aisha: provide time-limited staging keys by EOD Mon 14 Sep OR confirm we should use Redwood ephemeral flow.
- Tom: confirm kickoff time on Mon 20 Sep and procurement contacts for the trial (billing & trial cap).
- Rachel: share the eval harness link and test payloads (she'll follow up).
- Michael: populate the initial smoke-test logs to the shared tracker (staging-issue-log.csv).
- Neha: verify logging/retention configuration for EU-origin traffic.

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx; staging-issue-log.csv; redwood-staging-access-instructions.pdf

If everyone agrees, I will lock the tracker and send a calendar invite for the 30-min kickoff (Mon 20 Sep, 11:00am PT proposed). Please reply with any changes by EOD today.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
